# Composition example images

PNG files are generated by the original Azimlib renderer from
[clean_map.py](../../../examples/clean_map.py) and
[composition_atlas.py](../../../examples/composition_atlas.py).
Natural Earth boundary data remain public domain, with provenance in the
[dataset guide](../../data.md). Routes and symbols are synthetic/original.
Original example code is BSD-3-Clause (Kernerian). No Matplotlib code/assets
are used to produce these images. The manifest records exact export hashes;
PNG/SVG/HTML artifacts are retained separately for local validation.
